finding_addressed: PL-SCI-02 same-panel baseline/candidate/gain association before native atlas integration
receipt: Actual bytes and matching SHA256 required; schema_version1,kind CRS_LEARNING_ENDPOINT,payload exact endpoint schema
common_comparison_identity: Baseline/candidate match exact panel,scorer/version,endpoint/scope and canonical case-parent-variant-family membership before any difference
direction: higher_is_better; gain is candidate proportion minus baseline proportion
proportions: Finite strict int/float in[0,1],never booleans; independently check complete item-score numerator and scheduled denominator
operational_failure: Item operational failure is zero semantic/strict success and never abstention; unavailable/failed whole endpoints have null proportions and null gains even with retained partial items
declared_gain: Optional consistency assertion only; never input to efficiency. Reject0.9 for candidate0.1 and any inconsistent same-panel difference
tolerance_scope: Float fraction consistency only; no change to native numerical/resource gates
membership: Unique case IDs and parent-local variants,stable parent families,identical scheduled banks; expected_membership may additionally bind frozen case bank
native_integration_condition: Supply expected_membership from preregistered immutable panel; byte association and matched caller fields do not attest actual panel provenance,execution or causal dose comparison
atlas_v2_integration: Source/candidate checkpoint hashes and scorer hash match row; requested acquisition/transfer/retention metric estimate and scope match candidate endpoint; use unchanged atlas_v2 with exact derived gain and separate measurement receipt bytes
null_endpoint: No receipt hash may be claimed for missing bytes; difference and ratios remain undefined
association_not_attestation: Receipt byte/hash/field consistency does not prove native execution,qualification,authority,causal learning or frontier; all truth/promotion flags remainfalse
